title: chirita ridleyana

It is a type of flowering plant native to Borneo, which has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Chirita ridleyana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
